+
+# Variables:
+#   $count - number of new messages
+#   $account - name of the account

+    $count  ->
+        [one] { $account } received { $count } new message
+        *[other] { $account } received { $count } new messages

diff --git a/python/l10n/tb_fluent_migrations/bug_1935334_newmailalert.py b/python/l10n/tb_fluent_migrations/bug_1935334_newmailalert.py

index 00000000000..ac0f3ac2b9f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/python/l10n/tb_fluent_migrations/bug_1935334_newmailalert.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+#  This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+#  License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+#  file, You can obtain one at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+
+# Any copyright is dedicated to the Public Domain.
+# http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
+
+import fluent.syntax.ast as FTL
+from fluent.migratetb.helpers import VARIABLE_REFERENCE, transforms_from
+from fluent.migratetb.transforms import REPLACE, PLURALS, REPLACE_IN_TEXT
+
+
+def migrate(ctx):
+    """Bug 1935334 - Migrate newmailalert from PluralForm.sys.mjs, part {index}."""
+
+    source = "mail/chrome/messenger/messenger.properties"
+    target = reference = "mail/messenger/newmailalert.ftl"
+    ctx.add_transforms(
+        target,
+        reference,
+        [
+            FTL.Message(
+                id=FTL.Identifier("new-mail-alert-message"),
+                value=PLURALS(
+                    source,
+                    "newMailAlert_message",
+                    VARIABLE_REFERENCE("count"),
+                    foreach=lambda n: REPLACE_IN_TEXT(
+                        n,
+                        dict(
+                            {
+                                "#1": VARIABLE_REFERENCE("account"),
+                                "#2": VARIABLE_REFERENCE("count"),
+                            }
+                        ),
+                    ),
+                ),
+            )
+        ],
+    )
